The '''''Sigma''-class long-range shuttle''' was a lightly-armed [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] model used by the [[Fel Empire]] to ferry important individuals across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In comparison to the [[Nune-class Imperial shuttle|''Nune''-class Imperial shuttle]], which was often confined to one area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and doubled as a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]], the ''Sigma''-class shuttle was considered a luxury transport. The shuttle's amenities included large passenger quarters and a well-stocked galley; however, the class was not extravagant enough to be classified as a [[Luxury yacht/Legends|luxury yacht]]. The ''Sigma''-class was incapable of carrying any [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], but a modified variant employed by the [[Imperial Knight]]s could hold up to three [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class starfighters]].

==Characteristics==
Designed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], the ''Sigma''-class long-range [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was equipped with a Class 1.0 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and a Class 8.0 backup, along with a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]]. It was also outfitted with double heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and could carry ten passengers in addition to a minimum crew of one. The shuttle was able to hold three [[Standard month/Legends|months]]' worth of consumables, and it supported up to 200 [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of cargo.<ref name="LECG" />

A variant of the ''Sigma''-class was utilized by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s personal bodyguards, the [[Imperial Knight]]s. Such craft were able to carry a maximum of three [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class starfighters]] but only thirty tons of cargo as a result of the decrease in available space.<ref name="LECG" /> Painted in crimson, reminiscent of the color of the Knights' [[Armor/Legends|armor]], the variant bore the [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crest]] on its ventral surface and upper wing.<ref name="Legacy 24" />

==Role==
The ''Sigma''-class was often employed to transport high-ranking [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and other [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Whereas the [[Nune-class Imperial shuttle|''Nune''-class Imperial shuttle]] was limited to [[Planet/Legends|interplanetary]] travel in a given [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and commonly used as a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]], the ''Sigma''-class was quite the opposite. Though not as extravagant as a [[Luxury yacht/Legends|luxury yacht]], it was considered a luxury transport that provided comfort during long galactic travels. The interior of the shuttle consisted of a well-stocked kitchen, several large passenger compartments, and an open cargo space large enough to store personal [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]].<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
[[File:Ikship.jpg|thumb|right|210px|A ''Sigma''-class shuttle in profile]]
The ''Sigma''-class was favored by [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] officers who required a quick means of traveling throughout the galaxy and preferred to act as their own [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] or be accompanied only by a small retinue. Bureaucratic offices on planets throughout the Empire possessed a minimum of one ''Sigma''-class shuttle in operable condition should an official need a means of transport.<ref name="LECG" />

During the time of Fel's [[Empire-in-exile]] and the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], one of the Imperial Knights' ''Sigma''-class shuttles was utilized by Knights [[Marasiah Fel]], [[Antares Draco]], and [[Ganner Krieg]]<ref name="Legacy 24" /> during their mission to seek out an alliance with the remnants of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Legacy 25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref> To do so, they tracked down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]] in [[137 ABY]] using Imperial Knight [[Azlyn Rae]], a former friend of Skywalker's during their time as Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]], as their informant.<ref name="Legacy 24" /> The three Knights in their shuttle followed Skywalker's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], to the [[Hidden Temple]], a Jedi sanctuary on [[Taivas]].<ref name="Legacy 25" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Sigma''-class long-range shuttle first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[Legacy (2006) 24|twenty-fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]], illustrated by [[Jan Duursema]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 24" /> on [[May 21]], [[2008]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54396/star_wars_legacy_2006_24|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #24}}</ref> The shuttle was later identified in the [[2009]] ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'' supplement to the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''.<ref name="LECG" />
